title: Let This Grieving Soul Retire

premise: Krai Andrey and his childhood friends swore to become the greatest treasure hunters; his friends became legends, but Krai stayed ordinary. As leader of their party and clan, he keeps trying to retire, yet his blunders and luck are read by everyone as genius strategy, earning him an ever larger reputation. The comedy runs on this gap between perception and reality.
life_message: Friendship and loyalty carry a person further than talent, and reputation is often a misunderstanding.
